members.name: version
members.summary: The embedding API version (05 §8), separate from the protocol version.

members.name: release
members.summary: The release of this package (FE-001; ADR 0039).

members.name: getToken
members.summary: Called with `{ docId }` at start and when the token must be renewed.

members.name: backend
members.summary: Any implementation of the backend ports (05 §8.3); `endpoint` is then ignored.

members.name: config
members.summary: The configuration as the host set it; unknown keys are ignored (PRO-081).

members.name: resolveUsers
members.summary: Names and avatars from the host's directory (PRO-080); read whenever the shell asks.

members.name: searchPrincipals
members.summary: Users and groups for the grants dialog and mentions (PRO-080), which arrive in phase 1b.

members.name: strings
members.summary: The host's replacement strings by key (UX-063). A key the host omits falls back to the source table; a key no table knows is reported to the console.

members.name: extensions
members.summary: Host-registered extensions (13 §7, 05 §8.1). A change while the shell is mounted is applied at once (UX-050).

members.name: headerState
members.summary: What a host-drawn header shows, as it is now (UX-014 criterion 5; proposed, ADR 0361): the connection and save state of `de-status`, and the details of `de-mode-change`, `de-presence` and `de-counts`. Null until the editor is live. Read-only: identifiers, states and counts, no content and no token.

members.name: load
members.summary: Loads `docId` as if `doc-id` had changed; without an argument, or with the current one, reloads the current document (PRO-076).

members.name: focus
members.summary: Moves keyboard focus into the editing surface, with its last selection (FE-013; PRO-076).

members.name: flush
members.summary: Resolves when nothing is in flight or queued; rejects at `timeoutMs` with the number of unconfirmed commits (PRO-083). With no document loaded nothing can be unconfirmed.

members.name: getContent
members.summary: The confirmed document with its `seq` (PRO-084). Rejects when no document is loaded.

members.name: exec
members.summary: Runs a command through the path the toolbar uses; false when it does not apply, is unknown or no document is loaded (PRO-085). `command` is an identifier of the command registry such as `format.bold` (UX-005), or a name of the editing core such as `bold`.

members.name: queryCommand
members.summary: Whether a command is enabled and active for the user's access now (PRO-085).

members.name: nextField
members.summary: Moves focus to the next field the user may fill, after the one that last had focus (the first when none had). False when no field took focus, and with no document loaded (FRW-069).

members.name: focusField
members.summary: Moves focus to the field with `key`. For a key no field has it throws nothing and answers false, as it does with no document loaded (FRW-069).

members.name: getFieldValues
members.summary: The values of the form fields by key, as the document holds them now (FRW-069).

members.name: setFieldValue
members.summary: Fills the field with `key` as the current user, as typing into its control does; the server's permissions apply. Resolves with `{ ok: true, confirmed }`, or `{ ok: false, code, message }` with `permission_denied`, `field_invalid`, `conflict` or `not_found`; it does not reject (FRW-069).

members.name: validateFields
members.summary: The fields that are required and empty, or whose entry has a problem, in document order, with keys and reasons. It changes nothing (FRW-069).

members.name: getSelectionContent
members.summary: The selection as a CDM fragment (PRO-084); null when no document is loaded.

members.name: insertContent
members.summary: Inserts a CDM fragment at the selection through the same guards as typing (PRO-084). Nothing changes unless the result is `ok`; the result says why when it is not.

members.name: print
members.summary: Prints the typeset PDF of the loaded document (02 §9.8; FE-073). When the access lists `no-print`, nothing is requested and nothing is printed, and the outcome says why (FE-055; UX-040 criterion 3). Otherwise the export job runs and its PDF is printed through a hidden frame. Both print modules load on first use, so neither is on the connect-time path (FE-119).

members.name: requestExport
members.summary: Starts an export job of the loaded document and resolves `{ jobId }` (PRO-086). Refused when no document is loaded or the backend has no exports port (src/export.ts). The job's reports raise `de-export-progress`, `de-export-completed` or `de-export-failed` while the session that started it is still the current one (PRO-086).

members.name: destroy
members.summary: Unmounts the shell, destroys the editing core, closes the channel and the backend and stops every timer of the element; nothing more is raised (02 §2.1; PRO-076). Connecting the element again, or calling `load()`, starts afresh (ADR 0039).

events.name: de-ready
events.summary: The document is loaded and the editor is live (PRO-074).

events.name: de-status
events.summary: Connection or save state changed; at most once per animation frame (FE-007).

events.name: de-change
events.summary: Changes were confirmed up to `seq`; at most once per interval (PRO-087).

events.name: de-permission-change
events.summary: The access of the open channel, first from `ch.opened`, then from every `perm.changed` (PRO-088).

events.name: de-auth-required
events.summary: `getToken` failed or the server refused the token (PRO-075). Carries no token.

events.name: de-recovered-edits
events.summary: Rejected or unsent content was set aside; `count` is the number of pieces (05 §8.1).

events.name: de-share-request
events.summary: The owner asked for sharing, which the host owns (PRO-089; 13 §5). Identifiers only: the host opens its own dialog, and the editor shows none of its own. Nothing listens and nothing breaks when the host has no listener.

events.name: de-access-request
events.summary: A reader asked for access to hidden content (UX-104, ADR 0019). `scope` is the DEP scope identifier of the placeholder. The host decides who answers; the editor sends nothing itself.

events.name: de-export-progress
events.detail: { jobId: string; state: string; progress: number | null }
events.summary: An export job reports its state (PRO-086): identifiers and job state only, no content.

events.name: de-export-completed
events.detail: { jobId: string; state: string; progress: number | null }
events.summary: The export job completed (PRO-086). Same detail as `de-export-progress`.

events.name: de-export-failed
events.detail: { jobId: string; state: string; progress: number | null }
events.summary: The export job failed or was cancelled (PRO-086). Same detail as `de-export-progress`.

events.name: de-selection
events.summary: The selection moved to another scope or block (05 §8.1; FE-028). Identifiers only, no content.

events.name: de-command-state
events.summary: The commands whose `enabled` or `active` state changed, and only those (FE-028).

events.name: de-mode-change
events.summary: The mode in effect, or the mode asked for, changed; also raised once when the editor is live (UX-014 criterion 5; proposed, ADR 0361).

events.name: de-presence
events.summary: The other sessions this reader may see changed; also raised once when the editor is live (UX-014; ADR 0361).

events.name: de-counts
events.summary: The counts of the header's buttons changed; also raised once when the editor is live (UX-014; ADR 0361).

events.name: de-field-change
events.summary: This person changed the entry of a form field (12 §10; FRW-070). It carries no value.

events.name: de-fill-progress
events.summary: The progress the guided bar of fill mode shows changed (12 §10; FRW-070).

config.name: styleNonce
config.summary: Nonce for the <style> element the component creates when constructable stylesheets fail (02 section 3). Absent by default; an empty string counts as absent.

config.name: graceMs
config.summary: Grace period before a disconnected editor destroys itself, in milliseconds (02 section 2.1). Default 30,000. A negative or non-finite value is ignored.

config.name: pdfViewerUrl
config.summary: URL of the PDF viewer's page (FE-071). Default: viewer/pdf-viewer.html next to the module. Absent by default; an empty string counts as absent.

config.name: katexFontsUrl
config.summary: The directory, ending in a slash, that the host serves KaTeX's .woff2 files from (FE-069). The editor registers them under hash aliases. Absent by default: no KaTeX font is registered; an empty string counts as absent.

config.name: selectionShim
config.summary: Where the shadow root's getSelection comes from (02 section 8; spike S1 section 4.7). instance defines it on the editor's own root; library lets ProseMirror patch ShadowRoot.prototype.

config.name: footnoteModel
config.summary: Experimental, for spike evidence only: the footnote content model (03 section 13; CDM-001). paragraph is the CDM's footnote content; inline is the spike's option A.

config.name: deferRemoteWhileComposing
config.summary: Experimental, for spike evidence only: defer remote commits while the user composes text (input method).

config.name: forceStyleFallback
config.summary: Experimental, for spike evidence only: use the nonce <style> element even where constructable stylesheets work.

config.name: pageGuides
config.summary: Draws page guides in the web view where the last completed export's layout.json started a page (02 section 7; FE-068). Off by default; a guide is exact only at block starts and drifts between compiles.
